Prompts: REA_17 §3.4. · edge (catalyst pole only; owner 2026-10-16, THE EDGE v9: two sentences, the energy and its three ruling domains from the GOD table, then a clause per domain in The Pattern's voice; the metric; the head derived in the app)

candidates.structural_interaction: Water generating Wood same-polarity — depth as nourishing source of reach
candidates.k2_overview: Your Water moves as the Alchemist: depth studying itself. Knowledge does not sit in you, it dissolves, becoming a dark solution where fields merge and strange clarities precipitate. You understand what people have not said yet. The depth is real and isolating. Surface on a schedule, carrying one crystal at a time.
candidates.k2_functional: You think in solution: everything dissolved together until the pattern precipitates.

k2_domain_readings.Learning: You learn by immersion: total absorption until a field saturates and understanding crystallizes whole. Interrupted immersion loses everything, so defend the deep dives. Come up between them.
k2_domain_readings.Intuition: Your intuition is sonar: reading what moves beneath speech, sensing the shape of the unsaid. It is uncannily accurate about people. Verify before acting. Sonar shows shape, never color.
k2_domain_readings.Solitude: Your solitude is the deep itself: home pressure, true thinking depth. The danger is forgetting the surface has weather worth feeling. Schedule the ascent. Bring someone a pearl.

catalyst.define: As a catalyst, the intake runs short and you follow one stream to its source. What little comes in, you work out alone.

angles.drive: Going deep is how you learn best. Half-knowing bothers you more than not knowing at all, so you follow one question down until the floor shows. What you bring back up stays yours for life.
angles.cost_self: Where you go deepest is where you are most at home. You would rather stay down with one question than come up for the people and chances passing overhead. Invitations and openings wait for you and then go elsewhere.
angles.cost_others: Whenever you go deep, you go alone. Company slows you down, and you pick the quiet over any company you did not choose. Those close to you lose you for weeks at a time to a question.

angles.drive: You read what a person is not saying. A pause tells you more than the words around it, so you trust your feeling about someone over the story you are given. People feel understood around you before they have explained anything.
angles.cost_self: Reading a person before their words keeps you from surprises. The reading comes faster than the asking, and you go with it instead of waiting for the rest. Being right early leaves you knowing people without being close to them.
angles.cost_others: Where someone stops short, you read the rest and answer it. Reading them feels like care, and you answer the unsaid rather than wait to be told it. They never get to say it to you in their own words.

angles.drive: You teach yourself what matters most to you. A lesson you worked out alone sits deeper than one handed to you, and your own odd route comes before the course on offer. You lose years to the long way and would take it again.
angles.cost_self: Teaching yourself spares you being a beginner anywhere. Working it out alone feels easier than asking someone who knows, and the long road is the one you choose. Lessons a friend would have shown you in an afternoon take you a season.
angles.cost_others: You taught yourself your own route, and it is hard to pass on. Showing the steps means admitting there were none, and you hand over the answer rather than the method. Anyone learning from you gets a shortcut nobody else would have found.

friction.define: As a friction, the water rises faster than it drains, because you trust only what you know whole. Decisions wait while you turn each one over.

angles.drive: You think a decision over long after it stopped needing thought. You fear choosing wrong more than choosing late, and one more angle feels like care rather than delay. You never get the lesson that only a made choice could give you.
angles.cost_self: Thinking too much is your way of not being wrong. A wrong call scares you more than a late one, so you think a choice over past its day. You let chances close this way without a sound, and you lose sleep over them.
angles.cost_others: Whenever someone needs an answer, you think it over once more. Getting it right matters more to you than getting it to them, and you hand over the wait. You hold up their next step while you make the reply perfect.

angles.drive: You keep what you know in until it is finished, and it never is. More goes into you than comes out, because a half-formed thought let loose feels like a thought lost. Remember that what you let out half-formed is yours all the same.
angles.cost_self: Keeping it in keeps it from being judged. Inside is where an idea stays safe, and you hold yours back until it is perfect rather than let it out rough. You go unheard on the very things you understand best.
angles.cost_others: You keep in what others could use. A thought let out early feels broken to you, so you hold it in rather than hand it over. You make the people around you search alone for an answer you are holding.

angles.drive: You are hard to reach even from across the table. Most of you lives in an unfinished thought, and you would rather finish it than answer the person in front of you. You stay in your head and miss what was said to you.
angles.cost_self: Being hard to reach keeps your thinking whole. An interruption costs you the thread, so you answer late or not at all rather than lose it. You trade closeness for that thread each time, and closeness does not wait.
angles.cost_others: You are hard to reach while a thought is unfinished, and most of yours are. Finishing the thought comes before answering the message, and the person waiting hears nothing for days. You leave them with less of you than they came for.

edge.lead: Water runs through your mind, your growth and your career. It is the question you keep asking after the easy answer has come, the skill you learned your own way and own for good, and the read you have on someone before the handshake ends.
